Proposed test adjustment ```diff expectContains []string expectMissing []string + expectNil bool @@ { - name: "unknown arch returns nil", - arch: "riscv64", - fips: false, - expectMissing: []string{"console="}, + name: "unknown arch returns nil", + arch: "riscv64", + expectNil: true, + }, + { + name: "unknown arch with FIPS", + arch: "riscv64", + fips: true, + expectContains: []string{"fips=1"}, + expectMissing: []string{"console="}, }, @@ - if len(tc.expectContains) == 0 && len(tc.expectMissing) > 0 { + if tc.expectNil { assert.Nil(t, result, "kargs should be nil for unknown arch without FIPS") return } ```
